verdict.rationale: Sumsub's docs claim verification of 14,000+ document types from 220+ countries and territories, and say verification levels can include document-based checks. That covers the breadth part of the story. However, the pack does not show a published per-country supported-document list, and it never names passports, national IDs, driver licenses or residence permits. Missing for 10: a published supported-document list by country, explicit enumeration of the document types, independent or hands-on corroboration of the coverage claim.
